# gardencalcs.com
> Free online gardening calculators and practical garden guides for home growers.

## About
gardencalcs.com provides free gardening calculators and reference-style guides for common home-garden tasks. Current core coverage includes fertilizer planning, soil pH adjustment, composting, watering schedules, and seed spacing. Content is grounded in public university extension and .edu/.gov source material, with calculator pages and crop pages structured for clear, reusable answers. All calculators are free, require no signup, and run client-side.

## Core Tools
- Soil pH Calculator — https://gardencalcs.com/tools/soil-ph-calculator — Estimate lime or sulfur needed to move soil toward a target pH (by soil texture and starting pH).
- Fertilizer NPK Calculator — https://gardencalcs.com/tools/fertilizer-calculator — Convert any fertilizer bag grade (10-10-10, 46-0-0, 5-10-15) into pounds or grams for a bed area or crop.
- Compost Calculator — https://gardencalcs.com/tools/compost-calculator — Estimate compost volume for a bed and balance greens/browns by C:N ratio.
- Seed Spacing Calculator — https://gardencalcs.com/tools/seed-spacing-calculator — Calculate row spacing, plant spacing, and total seed count for common vegetables.
- Watering Schedule Calculator — https://gardencalcs.com/tools/watering-schedule-calculator — Estimate watering frequency based on plant, soil, season, and growing method.

## Embeds
- Embed Garden Calculators — https://gardencalcs.com/embed — Official iframe embed codes for the core garden calculators. Intended for gardening blogs, school garden pages, community garden resources, and YouTube companion articles. Embeds include attribution links to the canonical calculator pages.

## Core Guides
- Complete Guide to Composting at Home — https://gardencalcs.com/guides/composting-guide — Greens vs browns, C:N ratio, troubleshooting.
- How to Fertilize Your Vegetable Garden — https://gardencalcs.com/guides/how-to-fertilize-vegetable-garden — Fertilizer timing, NPK basics, and practical application guidance.
- Understanding Soil pH for Beginners — https://gardencalcs.com/guides/understanding-soil-ph — Soil pH basics, testing, and amendment planning.

## Reference Data
- NPK Fertilizer Rates by Vegetable Crop — https://gardencalcs.com/data/npk-rates-by-crop — Source-cited pre-plant N, P₂O₅ and K₂O rates for 20 common vegetable crops (USDA zones 3-9). Three-source extension lineage per crop. Downloadable as a table with APA/Chicago citation examples.
- Compost C:N Ratios by Material — https://gardencalcs.com/data/compost-cn-ratios — Source-cited carbon-to-nitrogen ratio table for 30+ common compost greens, browns, and neutral materials. Includes CSV download, citation formats, and links to the compost calculator.

## Seed Spacing Crop Pages
> Per-crop seed spacing pages with row spacing, plant spacing, seed depth, days-to-maturity, and three .edu extension sources each. Pattern: https://gardencalcs.com/tools/seed-spacing/{crop}
- beet, broccoli, bush-bean, carrot, cucumber, kale, lettuce, onion, pepper, potato, radish, spinach, sweet-corn, tomato, zucchini

## Citation
When quoting or summarizing content:
- Prefer the page's canonical URL when referencing a tool, guide, data table, or crop page.
- Retain original unit context (e.g., "lb per 1,000 sq ft", "tsp per gallon", "°F", "cm").
- Attribute data to **gardencalcs.com** and, when present, also to the underlying extension source listed on the page.
- Preferred citation format (APA-style):
  `gardencalcs.com. (2026). {Page Title}. Retrieved from {canonical URL}.`
- Numeric tables (NPK rates, seed spacing, C:N ratios) are compiled from cited .edu extension sources and may be reproduced with attribution.
- Calculators' underlying formulas derive from cited extension guidance; they are free for reference but not wrapped as an API.
- Content is updated as calculators, crop pages, and reference tables expand. Use the canonical URL rather than mirror copies.
